intent.subtype: input port conditionally left floating (driven with z) depending on a run-time input
intent.rationale: The load input of lfsr7 is driven only while seed_valid is high and is left at z otherwise; whether the input floats depends on the run-time value of seed_valid, which the file does not constrain.

labels.note: Input load is connected to an expression that is 1'bz when seed_valid is low, leaving the input without a driver and used as a condition.
labels.other: LC14 line 34: Z used as a mux value feeding a condition

labels.note: Input load is connected to 1'bz whenever seed_valid is low, so it floats/undefined.
labels.other: LC14 line 34: Z driven into logic input

settlement.note: Input load of u_lfsr is connected to an expression that is 1'bz when seed_valid is low: a floating input connection (and Z in design logic) is structural, so bad whatever seed_valid does.
